name: Msty
tagline: Privacy-focused local AI desktop client supporting Ollama, local models, RAG knowledge stacks, and split chat.
real_test_summary: Tested running local models side-by-side in split chat panes with offline knowledge stacks. Keeps prompts and local document context on device without cloud accounts.
pros: Side-by-side split chat comparison and offline knowledge stacks
Works smoothly with local Ollama and on-device models
Clean desktop workflow with zero mandatory sign-up
cons: Some advanced team features target desktop power workflows
Requires downloading local GGUF models for offline use
